sources.summary: Brief Variant 2: Apex Trust full multi-product collections brief with four products, identity, bands, amounts, promises, notes, transfers and closing table.

first_sentence.template: This is the digital assistant calling from Apex Trust. This call is recorded.

opening.ai_question_answer: I am Apex Trust's digital assistant.
opening.scam_question_answer: You can verify this call by phoning Apex Trust's customer service number.

on_customer_deceased.sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

questions.prompt: Can you confirm the last four digits of the phone number on file?
What is your date of birth?

answer_format.notes: Callers say the date in words; the agent converts it to YYYY-MM-DD.

debt_statement.intro: I am calling from the accounts team about overdue balances.

promise_rules.first_ask: Can you promise on all four products today?

readback.template: Read all promises back together, then ask: Do you confirm?

promise_rules.success_sentence: You will receive a text message confirming these promises.
forbidden_offers: any term not in the brief

attempts.note: Propose the deadline with the full amount. Recent and aged bands.
Propose the deadline with the floor amount. Recent band only.

persuasion.flat_refusal_definition: A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt per product.

intents.name: hardship
triggers: customer mentions a death in the family
intents.notes: For that product only. If the customer later names a date or amount for that product, record a promise instead.

intents.name: already_paid
intents.notes: For that product. Take no promise for it.

intents.name: restructuring_request
intents.notes: Do not record any notes before the transfer.

intents.name: human_request
triggers: I want to speak to a person
intents.notes: Ask once whether you can help. If they insist, transfer to general. Do not record any notes before the transfer. The brief gives no action for a customer who accepts help.

actions.text: You can verify this call by phoning Apex Trust's customer service number.

intents.name: unknown_question
triggers: a question the agent cannot answer

actions.text: I do not have that information.

intents.name: does_not_want_to_talk
triggers: I do not want to talk

outcome_table.when: At least one promise was recorded.
All products marked as already paid (first product's note is paid).
All products refused, none promised; or customer says twice they do not want to talk.
No promise and the first product's note is hardship.
No promise and the first product's note is dispute.
System failure prevented recording any promise.
Human support transfer requested and honored.
Someone else answered and no valid callback time was offered.
The person says the number does not belong to the customer.
The person says the customer has died.
Customer identity still unclear after the second ask.
Customer declines to answer after the explanation.

verify_identity.notes: Check one security answer at a time, in the order of identity questions. Three wrong answers in total end the check.

get_account.purpose: Get the late products. Refused until both questions are passed.

create_promise.notes: Call once per product with a promise. Say recorded only after ok is true.

add_note.notes: Once per product without a promise.

transfer_to_agent.notes: Brief uses queues restructuring and general.

close_call.notes: Always the last tool call. Reason required for every outcome except promise and paid. Brief outcome names promised, declined and no_contact map to promise, no_promise and not_reached. Brief outcome service_error has no API value and is mapped to no_promise with reason service_error.

mandated_sentences.when: Someone else answers and the customer has died
mandated_sentences.text: I am sorry for your loss.

mandated_sentences.when: Start of promise discussion, before going product by product
mandated_sentences.text: Can you promise on all four products today?

mandated_sentences.when: Before close, after all products are discussed: read promises back and ask for confirmation

mandated_sentences.text: You will receive a text message confirming these promises.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Opening and who is on the line, rule 1
verbatim_rules.text: First sentence: say you are a digital assistant calling from Apex Trust, and that the call is recorded. Do not say collections, debt, payment or the products before identity is verified.
If the customer asks whether you are a robot or an AI, say that you are Apex Trust's digital assistant and continue.
Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence. Ask when the customer can be reached.

A callback is for today or the next business day, with these hours: Monday through Wednesday 8:00 to 18:00 both included; Thursday 9:00 to 16:00 both included; Friday not available (do not schedule Friday callbacks). The time must be later than now. Call schedule_callback with the date and the time, then close as not_reached / callback.
If the person offers a day or a time outside that window, ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule. Close as not_reached / no_callback.
Ask two security questions, one at a time: first the last four digits of the phone number on file, then your date of birth. Call verify_identity after each answer.
A wrong answer may be asked again. Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.
After three wrong answers, do not state the debts. Tell the customer to use the mobile app or contact a branch. Close as not_verified / failed.
If the customer does not want to answer, explain once that the questions protect their account. If they still decline, close as not_verified / declined.
Callers say dates in words; the agent converts them to YYYY-MM-DD. An unreadable value is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer.
After all four questions pass, call get_account.

Say that you are calling from the accounts team about overdue balances. Name each product: business credit line 6543, equipment lease 7654, inventory loan 8765, cash advance 9876. State each past-due amount and days overdue, in the order get_account returned them.
A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline for that product.
If the customer names a weekend day or holiday, offer the next business day. If the named day is after the product's deadline, rule 19 applies.

If the customer asks for a date after a product's deadline, say the latest date you can record for that product is its deadline and offer it. If the customer refuses, treat it as a refusal for that product.
Floor: Business credit line 15% of full past-due; Equipment lease $5,000 (fixed); Inventory loan 20% of full past-due; Cash advance $2,000 (fixed).
If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses, treat it as a refusal for that product.
If not all four products can be promised today, go through products one at a time in the order get_account returned them.
When attempts are exhausted for a product, move to the next. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

If the customer mentions illness, job loss, or a death in the family, say one short sentence of sympathy. Do not make a persuasion attempt. For that product, call add_note with reason hardship. If the customer later names a date or amount themselves for that product, record a promise instead.
Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in this brief.
If the customer changes a date or amount when confirming, check it against the Dates and bands and Amounts sections and read it back again.
For each product with a promise, say it is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true. If it fails twice, call add_note with reason service_error for that product.
After confirmation, call create_promise once per product with a promise. Call add_note once per product without a promise, with reason refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 36
verbatim_rules.text: I already paid: for that product, take no promise and record add_note with reason paid. Continue with other products.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 37
verbatim_rules.text: This debt is not mine: do not argue. For that product, record add_note with reason dispute and continue.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 38
verbatim_rules.text: A request for restructuring, lower instalments, or a new plan: call transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring. Do not record any notes before the transfer. Close as transferred / restructuring.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 39
verbatim_rules.text: A request for human support: ask once whether you can help. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general. Do not record any notes before the transfer. Close as transferred / human.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 40
verbatim_rules.text: Is this a scam?: say they can verify the call by phoning Apex Trust's customer service number, and continue.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 41
verbatim_rules.text: A question you cannot answer: say you do not have that information.

verbatim_rules.source_ref: Brief: Other things customers say, rule 42
verbatim_rules.text: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk, close as no_promise / refused.
Thank the customer and say goodbye before close_call.
Every call ends with exactly one close_call, with an outcome and reason if applicable.
If all products get notes (no promises), check the first product's note: if paid, close as paid; otherwise close as no_promise with that reason. If any product gets a promise, close as promised.
Apex Trust calls business customers who are 1 to 90 business days overdue on one to four products.
If the customer gives a vague period ("next week", "end of the month"), ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

warnings: Outcome names in the brief (promised, declined, transferred, no_contact, service_error, paid) do not all match the close_call API enum (promise, paid, transferred, no_promise, not_verified, not_reached). Mapped by meaning: promised->promise, declined->no_promise with reason refused, no_contact->not_reached, service_error->no_promise with reason service_error.

Brief closing table and per-rule closes disagree with each other: rule 12 and 13 use not_verified, rule 6-9 use not_reached, and the closing table lists 'declined' as a close outcome. The API outcome names were used instead.
Brief rule 12 says close as not_verified / failed; rule 13 says not_verified / declined. Both are kept as separate outcome rows.

Product types: the brief names four products (business credit line, equipment lease, inventory loan, cash advance) but the API product types are credit_card, personal_loan and car_loan. No mapping is stated, so product_names in debt_statement and floor_fields are omitted. Products are described in verbatim rules.

Floor amounts (15% / $5,000 / 20% / $2,000) are not held in any account field the API returns, so floor_fields and floor_default_field are omitted. Floor rules are kept verbatim. Percentages apply to full past-due amount.
Account response has no field for the floor; the full amount is taken from past_due. Below-floor behaviour is not stated and is omitted.
Currency is not stated as a code; the brief uses dollar signs. Currency is omitted.
Calendar week_starts_on is not stated and is omitted.
Band boundaries: brief intro says customers are 1 to 90 business days overdue, while the band table uses Days Late. Days late 0 and above 90 are not covered by any band.
Band deadlines use business_days_after_today; no roll rule is needed or stated.
Persuasion: no on_exhausted outcome is stated; brief only says move to the next product. Omitted.
Rule 17 refers to rule 19 for days after deadline, but rule 19 is the weekday rule; rule 20 is the deadline rule. Rule 20 was applied.
Identity question prompts are not given in the brief; the prompt wording is a neutral placeholder and must be checked.
Numeric reading order for date of birth is not stated; omitted. Brief does not explain hint day_month_swapped or whether it counts as wrong; no hints entry was created.
Declining explanation text is paraphrased from rule 13 ('the questions protect their account').
Mobile app / branch failure sentence is paraphrased from rule 12 and kept in verbatim rules, not as a say action.
Sympathy sentence is not given word for word; sympathy action is used without text.
Opening first sentence is a paraphrase of rule 1; exact wording is not given.

Callback window: the brief gives different hours per weekday (Mon-Wed 8-18, Thu 9-16, Fri none). The schema has one hour range, so 08:00-18:00 inclusive is recorded and the per-day table is in verbatim rules. Thursday and Friday restrictions must be enforced from verbatim rules.
Human transfer: the brief says ask once whether you can help; the case where the customer accepts help is not stated. The ask_once action has no decline branch.
Multi-product one_date_for_all and capped deadline announcement are not stated; omitted. Brief rule 20 gives the say-latest-date wording but no capped read-back wording.
Rule 36-37 notes: 'keep_recorded_promises' and 'drop_unrecorded_promises' on transfer are not stated; omitted.
all_notes_equal and first_note_not_equal aggregation: brief gives only the first-note rule; the mapping to all_notes_equal (paid) and first_note_not_equal (no_promise) is an interpretation.
Closing goodbye text is not stated; only that goodbye is required.
Promise failure outcome (on_failure) is not stated beyond the add_note service_error rule; omitted.
Retries: 'If it fails twice, call add_note with service_error' was read as one retry (retries_on_failure 1).
Rule 40 scam answer is also placed in opening.scam_question_answer; rule 41 unknown question is an intent action.
Intent for 'does not want to talk' trigger phrase is paraphrased from rule 42; hardship triggers are paraphrased from rule 29.
Brief description 'Brief B' in add_note API is a tool description, not a rule in this brief; no override applied.
